caption:
Four names of Allah in one short verse

Allah describes Himself as the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, All-Knowing of everything. Nothing in your life is outside His knowledge.

Surah Al-Hadid 57:3

Which of these four names will you reflect on tonight?

#namesofallah #asmaulhusna #surahhadid #tawheed

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
